title: Discovering the 25-year-old hip pin had broken
summary: Doctors found by accident that the pin put in his hip in 1950 had broken, though he felt no difference until recently.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: How did you happen to break the pin in your hip?
Well, when they put it in there 25 years ago, 1950, they told me, some day it would go, you know. And so aw, what the hell. Wherever I'd be, by then I figured 25 years is -- you know.
So I'm still here. So, they had me in the hospital, going through some tests, and this and that and

the other, and a year ago they sent for me to come up. Said, Mr. Autrey! The pin in your leg -- I said oh, no! I didn't know -- I was sitting down taking tests for something else, and they saw where the damn pin had broke in my hip. I didn't know.
Oh, you didn't know it, huh?
No, heck, I couldn't feel any difference.

So laying flat on my back, I guess they had taken pictures of my kidneys, and other things that happened, and liver, and junk, and they saw this damn thing was broken. So they had me to come in, and they said well, how do you feel? Do this. Do that. Do the other.

I said yeah, Yeah, what the hell. I can do it. So a couple -- well, about three weeks ago they had me back again. So I went in there and laughed at them. Since then I come home, I said hah, hah, hah, I've got to go to the hospital, and the thing was hurting like hell then.
Oh, all of a sudden it acted up, huh?
But actually, until then it hadn't bothered you at all.
No. No, I mean once in a while it --

well You -- I guess you figure, well, it's a rainy day, or I didn't get enough rest week, or that few days. Maybe that's why. You pass it off. I -- which I have done quite a lot of times. And I say ah, it'll be all right tomorrow. And it would be all right. So I got away with it, so for stuff like that,
